def memory_temporaries(db):
    # TEMP_STORE=0 overrides PRAGMA temp_store and can still spill to disk.
    # Refuse it before running integrity checks, sorting or backup queries.
    options=[r[0] for r in db.execute('PRAGMA compile_options')]
    settings=[value for value in options if value.startswith('TEMP_STORE=')]
    require(len(settings)==1 and settings[0] in ('TEMP_STORE=1','TEMP_STORE=2','TEMP_STORE=3'),
        'SQLite build must support memory-only temporary storage')
    db.execute('PRAGMA temp_store=MEMORY')
    require(db.execute('PRAGMA temp_store').fetchone()==(2,),
        'SQLite memory temporary storage was not accepted')

def collect_full_schema(db):
    collection_proof()
    require(db.in_transaction and db.execute('PRAGMA query_only').fetchone()==(1,),
        'Full schema must share the owned logical read transaction')
    require(db.execute('PRAGMA encoding').fetchone()==('UTF-8',),'Only explicit UTF-8 schema observations are supported')
    rows=[];total=0
    for row in db.execute(FULL_SCHEMA_SQL):
        item=list(row);size=len(canonical(item))+1
        require(len(rows)<100000 and total+size<=SCHEMA_LIMIT-512,
            'Complete schema exceeds its retained original envelope; no rows may be omitted')
        rows.append(item);total+=size
    value={'version':1,'scope':'DECLARED_COMPLETE_SQLITE_SCHEMA','encoding':1,'rows':rows}
    declared_schema(value)
    require(len(canonical(value))+1<=SCHEMA_LIMIT,'Complete schema original too large')
    return value

def state_binding(schema,state):
    declared_schema(schema)
    require(type(state) is dict and set(state)=={'objects','tables','integrity','foreignKeyViolations'} and
        state['integrity']=='ok' and type(state['foreignKeyViolations']) is int and state['foreignKeyViolations']==0 and
        type(state['tables']) is dict,'Successful complete logical-state original required')
    rows=schema['rows'];objects=[[r[0],r[1],r[2],r[4]] for r in rows if not r[1].startswith('sqlite_')]
    require(canonical(objects)==canonical(state['objects']) and
        set(state['tables'])=={r[1] for r in rows if r[0]=='table' and not r[1].startswith('sqlite_')},
        'Exact complete schema/logical table inventory required')
    for name,table in state['tables'].items():
        require(type(table) is dict and set(table)=={'columns','count','sha256'} and
            type(table['columns']) is list and 1<=len(table['columns'])<=2000 and
            all(type(c) is str and c and '\0' not in c for c in table['columns']) and
            len(set(table['columns']))==len(table['columns']) and
            type(table['sha256']) is str and re.fullmatch('[a-f0-9]{64}',table['sha256']),'Exact ordinary logical table columns/fingerprint required')
        integer(table['count'],9223372036854775807)

def collect_record_profiles(db,schema,state):
    """Called only within an existing NEW owned-reader readonly transaction."""
    _,digest=source_proof();state_binding(schema,state)
    require(db.in_transaction and db.execute('PRAGMA query_only').fetchone()==(1,) and
        db.execute('PRAGMA encoding').fetchone()==('UTF-8',) and
        db.execute('PRAGMA temp_store').fetchone()==(2,),'Owned UTF8/query-only/memory-temp read transaction required')
    databases=list(db.execute('PRAGMA database_list'));main=[r for r in databases if r[1]=='main']
    require(len(main)==1 and all(r[1] in ('main','temp') for r in databases),'No attached database record profile supported')
    path=pathlib.Path(main[0][2]);require(path.is_absolute() and path.name=='dev.db' and path.parent.name=='reader' and
        path.resolve()==path,'Only canonical NEW owned reader/dev.db is supported')
    for suffix in ('','-wal','-shm'):
        p=pathlib.Path(str(path)+suffix)
        if p.exists():require(p.stat().st_nlink==1 and p.stat().st_dev==path.stat().st_dev,'Independent same-device owned reader files required')
    db.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM main.sqlite_schema').fetchone()  # establish THIS owned read snapshot before hashing
    before=triple(path);info=path.parent.stat();directory=[info.st_dev,info.st_ino,stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode)]
    require(canonical(collect_full_schema(db))==canonical(schema),'Record scan schema changed within owned read transaction')
    tables={}
    for name,table in sorted(state['tables'].items()):
        actual=list(db.execute('PRAGMA main.table_xinfo('+quote(name)+')'))
        require([r[1] for r in actual]==table['columns'] and all(r[6]==0 for r in actual),
            'Generated/hidden/missing/changed projection columns refused')
        maxima=[]
        for column in table['columns']:
            c=quote(column)
            data="CASE typeof("+c+") WHEN 'null' THEN 0 WHEN 'integer' THEN 8 WHEN 'real' THEN 8 WHEN 'text' THEN length(CAST("+c+" AS BLOB)) WHEN 'blob' THEN length("+c+") ELSE -1 END"
            sql='SELECT count(*),max('+data+'),min('+data+') FROM main.'+quote(name)
            count,maximum,minimum=db.execute(sql).fetchone();integer(count,9223372036854775807)
            require(count==table['count'],'Complete table record scan count differs from logical original')
            if count==0:require(maximum is None and minimum is None,'Empty native aggregate profile differs');maximum=0
            else:integer(minimum);integer(maximum)
            maxima.append(maximum)
        tables[name]={'columns':list(table['columns']),'rowCount':table['count'],'maximumNativeDataBytesByColumn':maxima,
            'maximumFullSelectedRowRecordBytes':full_record_bound(maxima)}
    after=triple(path);end=path.parent.stat()
    require(canonical(before)==canonical(after) and directory==[end.st_dev,end.st_ino,stat.S_IMODE(end.st_mode)],
        'Owned reader bytes/file identities/directory changed during record observation')
    value={'version':1,'scope':'OWNED_READER_NATIVE_RECORD_PROFILE_OBSERVATION','sourceProofSha256':digest,
        'schemaSha256':sha(canonical(schema)),'logicalStateOriginal':{'bytes':len(canonical(state))+1,'sha256':sha(canonical(state)+b'\n')},
        'collectorEngineVersion':db.execute('SELECT sqlite_version()').fetchone()[0],
        'collectorEngineSourceId':db.execute('SELECT sqlite_source_id()').fetchone()[0],
        'readerPath':str(path),'readerDirectoryIdentity':directory,'originalFiles':before,'tables':tables,
        'readTransactionAndRestrictedReaderPathChecked':True,'queryOnlyUtf8AndMemoryTempChecked':True,
        'schemaAndRecordScanShareTransaction':True,'newReaderCreationAndCallerBindingVerified':False,
        'preSqlCapacityAdmissionVerified':False,'standardBuiltinFunctionsRuntimeVerified':False,
        'kernelQuiescenceVerified':False,'independentProfileToPrivateDbBytesProof':False,
        'captureCollectorIntegrationImplemented':False,'runtimeBinaryToSourceBindingVerified':False,
        'writerGraphAdmissionImplemented':False,'physicalFilesystemClosureClaimed':False}
    validate_profile(value,schema,state);return value

def seal(root,label,source,check,live_source=False,schema_original=None):
    if schema_original is not None:
        from kit_schema_collection import SCHEMA_ORIGINALS
        names={'fresh-production-snapshot':'capture-schema-initial.json',
            'capture-prepared-206':'capture-schema-206.json','capture-prepared-214':'capture-schema-214.json'}
        require(label in names and schema_original==names[label] and schema_original in SCHEMA_ORIGINALS and
            not (pathlib.Path(root)/schema_original).exists() and not (pathlib.Path(root)/schema_original).is_symlink(),
            'Exact unused capture schema original required before seal creation')
    d=child_path(root,pathlib.Path(root)/label);require(not d.exists(),'Seal consumed')
    require(not live_source or label=='fresh-production-snapshot','Only the production seal uses a live handoff')
    claim_copy(check,'seal-directory');admit_copy(check,'seal-directory',d,[],1)
    d.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    raw,original=copy_triple(source,d/'raw',check,live_source);reader,_=copy_triple(raw,d/'reader',check)
    for s,r in triple(reader).items():
        if r is not None:pathlib.Path(str(reader)+s).chmod(0o600)
    index_bound=reader_index_bound(reader,check)
    reader_before=identity_record(triple(reader))
    observed=logical(reader,full_schema=schema_original is not None)
    state,schema=observed if schema_original is not None else (observed,None)
    verify_reader_index(reader,index_bound);backup=d/'backup.db'
    # WAL is read by a normal read-only connection to the OWNED reader. immutable=1 is never used here.
    claim_copy(check,'backup')
    before=sqlite3.connect(reader.as_uri()+'?mode=ro',uri=True,timeout=10);after=None
    try:
        memory_temporaries(before);before.execute('PRAGMA query_only=ON');before.execute('BEGIN')
        # Pin one OWNED-reader snapshot before sizing or creating destination.
        # A progress callback after a backup step is not a pre-write ceiling.
        pages=before.execute('PRAGMA page_count').fetchone()[0]
        page_size=before.execute('PRAGMA page_size').fetchone()[0]
        require(type(pages) is int and pages>0 and type(page_size) is int and
            512<=page_size<=65536 and page_size&(page_size-1)==0 and pages*page_size<=BYTE_LIMIT,
            'Exact bounded owned-reader backup page layout required')
        admit_copy(check,'backup',backup,[pages*page_size],0)
        with backup.open('xb') as stream:stream.flush();os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        after=sqlite3.connect(str(backup));memory_temporaries(after)
        require(after.execute('PRAGMA journal_mode=MEMORY').fetchone()==('memory',),
            'Detached backup memory rollback journal required')
        before.backup(after,pages=256,sleep=0.05)
        # Backup can copy the WAL-mode header from the source. Normalize only
        # this NEW detached output before sealing; raw masters remain exact.
        require(after.execute('PRAGMA journal_mode=MEMORY').fetchone()==('memory',),
            'Detached output inherited an unsupported journal mode')
        require(backup.stat().st_size==pages*page_size,'Owned backup exceeded or differs from pinned source page layout')
    finally:
        if after is not None:after.close()
        before.close()
    verify_reader_index(reader,index_bound)
    require(not any(pathlib.Path(str(backup)+suffix).exists() for suffix in ('-journal','-wal','-shm')),
        'Detached backup has unexpected SQLite side files')
    with backup.open('r+b') as stream:stream.flush();os.fsync(stream.fileno())
    backup.chmod(0o400)
    detached=logical(backup,full_schema=schema_original is not None)
    require(detached==((state,schema) if schema_original is not None else state),'Detached WAL-aware backup or full schema differs')
    handoff=exact_json((d/'raw/snapshot-handoff.json').read_bytes()) if live_source else None
    require((live_source or triple(source)==original) and identity_record(triple(raw))==(handoff['rawCopyByteIdentity'] if live_source else identity_record(original)),'Original or raw master changed while reading owned copy')
    if schema_original is not None:
        from kit_schema_collection import SCHEMA_ORIGINALS,schema_observation
        require(schema_original in SCHEMA_ORIGINALS,'Only the three declared capture schema original names are supported')
        observation=schema_observation(label,schema,state,identity_record(original),identity_record(triple(raw)),
            reader_before,identity_record(triple(reader)),identity_record({'':file_state(backup)})[''])
        write_new(pathlib.Path(root)/schema_original,observation)
    write_new(d/'logical-state.json',state);write_new(d/'seal.json',{'rawMaster':str(raw),'rawMasterNeverOpenedSqlite':True,'backup':str(backup),'backupSha256':file_state(backup)['sha256'],'logicalStateSha256':sha(canonical(state)),'originalFiles':original,'countsIncludeWal':True,'productionSnapshotHandoff':handoff})
    check();return backup,state
